title: MODIS Burned Area Monthly 500 m (MCD64A1 Version 6.1)
description: Monthly global gridded burned-area product at 500 m from combined Terra and Aqua MODIS, giving per-pixel burn date (day of year), burn-date uncertainty, first/last day of reliable change detection and quality flags.
purpose: Mapping and trend analysis of burned area in Algeria since November 2000, e.g. post-fire assessment of summer forest fires in the Tell Atlas and comparison with active-fire detections.

provider.name: NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC)

creator: Giglio, L., Justice, C., Boschetti, L., Roy, D. (MODIS Burned Area team, University of Maryland)

license.name: NASA EOSDIS data: openly shared without restriction (CC0 unless otherwise marked)

license_notes: The catalog page states the dataset 'is openly shared, without restriction' under the EOSDIS Data Use and Citation Guidance; NASA strongly urges users to cite the dataset DOI.
citation: Giglio, L., Justice, C., Boschetti, L., & Roy, D. (2021). MODIS/Terra+Aqua Burned Area Monthly L3 Global 500m SIN Grid V061 [Data set]. NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MCD64A1.061

references.citation: Giglio, L., Boschetti, L., Roy, D. P., Humber, M. L., and Justice, C. O. (2018). The Collection 6 MODIS burned area mapping algorithm and product. Remote Sensing of Environment, 217, 72-85.
Boschetti, L., Roy, D. P., Giglio, L., Huang, H., Zubkova, M., and Humber, M. L. (2019). Global validation of the collection 6 MODIS burned area product. Remote Sensing of Environment, 235, 111490.

spatial_extent.description: Global land in MODIS sinusoidal 10x10 degree tiles. Algeria spans several tiles that must be mosaicked, reprojected and clipped (or subset via AppEEARS).

temporal_extent.description: From November 2000 to present (latest granule found in NASA CMR on 2026-11-19: September 2026, A2026244). Pre-November 2000 is not distributed; June 2001 is heavily degraded (Terra outage).

resolution.spatial: 500 m nominal (463.3 m actual sinusoidal grid cell)

variables.name: Burn Date
variables.description: Ordinal day of burn (1-366); 0 = unburned land, -1 = unmapped due to insufficient data, -2 = water (user guide)

variables.name: Burn Date Uncertainty
variables.description: Estimated uncertainty in burn day (0-100; fill 0)

variables.name: First Day
variables.description: First day of the year of reliable change detection

variables.name: Last Day
variables.description: Last day of the year of reliable change detection

processing: Uses 500 m MODIS surface reflectance combined with 1 km MODIS active fire observations; a burn-sensitive vegetation index with dynamic thresholds is applied, with cumulative active-fire maps guiding the selection of burned and unburned training samples; burn dates are stored as day of year (Giglio et al. 2018). Collection 6.1 made no algorithm or product changes relative to Collection 6 for MCD64A1 (user guide).
validation: Per the MCD64 Collection 6.1 user guide, the Collection 6 product was validated at Stage 3 against 558 Landsat 8 OLI image pairs (2014-2015): global estimated commission error 40.2%, omission error 72.6% and bias in burned area -54.1% relative to Landsat reference data; errors largely compensate at coarser (3-6 km) scales (r2 > 0.70). The large negative bias is attributed primarily to systematic underestimation of smaller burned areas (Boschetti et al. 2019).
limitations: High omission of small burned areas at 500 m (global omission error 72.6% vs Landsat reference); total burned area is underestimated.
Burned areas in cropland should be treated as low confidence (user guide 'Known Problems'), relevant to stubble burning in Algerian cereal areas.
June 2001 is heavily degraded; no data before November 2000.
Product depends on Terra and Aqua MODIS; NASA states Terra observations are scheduled to cease on 1 December 2026, which may affect future production.
Sinusoidal HDF tiles require reprojection; University of Maryland GeoTIFF/shapefile versions are on an SFTP server (fuoco.geog.umd.edu) with credentials given in the user guide.

algeria_notes: Captures large summer forest and maquis fires in northern Algeria, but many small fires and agricultural burns will be missed or should be treated as low confidence; combine with FIRMS VIIRS active fires and Sentinel-2/Landsat for fire-scar mapping.
